title: Validate Stack Sequences
statement: Both arrays are permutations of the same distinct values. Decide whether some interleaving of pushes and pops on an initially empty stack produces exactly these push and pop orders.
constraints: popped is a permutation of pushed and all values are distinct
pushes must happen in the order given, and so must pops
hints: You do not need to search over interleavings. At every moment there is only one sensible move.
Simulate: push the next value, then pop greedily for as long as the stack top matches the next value expected in popped.
Greedy is safe because if the top matches the next expected pop and you do not take it, it is buried forever. At the end the sequence is valid exactly when the stack has emptied.
